SYMPTOM: Many memories from cleanup sessions stored under project ID 'Productive' aren't surfacing in retrieval.

CAUSE: Hooks derive project ID from last directory component of cwd. For ~/Desktop/Projects/memory, projectId = 'memory'. Old memories were stored when the project was named 'Productive'.

CURRENT STATE:
- ~/.local/share/memory/projects/memory/ — 9 active project memories (current)
- ~/.local/share/memory/projects/Productive/ — 17 memories (from cleanup, not surfacing)
- ~/.local/share/memory/global/ — 8 global memories (surfacing correctly)

FIX OPTIONS:
1. Migrate Productive memories into memory project (rename folder)
2. Leave as-is — Productive memories are mostly about the old codebase state anyway
3. Add project ID aliasing to store.ts

Not yet resolved.
